name: Alice's
note: Popular motorcycle meetup spot at Skyline Blvd (CA 35) and La Honda Road (CA 84), with a gas station and deli at the junction.

name: Saratoga Gap
note: Skyline Blvd (CA 35) × Highway 9, where the front side becomes the back side.

name: Chevron
note: Popular meetup spot in downtown Saratoga before heading up Highway 9. Sells race fuel.

name: Hwy 9 Viewpoint
note: Parking pullout on the back side of Highway 9, with an overlook and bathrooms.

name: Skyline Vista Point
note: Panoramic views of the Bay Area from Skyline Blvd (CA 35), looking directly out over Stanford.

name: Downtown Pescadero
note: A small downtown with cute coffee shops and lots of character. A lovely place to stretch your legs and grab a coffee before heading back to the coast.

name: Ritz-Carlton
note: The Ritz-Carlton, Half Moon Bay: great ocean views and a place to grab a drink, just off Highway 1 on Miramontes Point Road. Don’t drink and drive.
